# CRUD spec (t07-implement-crud-spec)

Built against API v1 (style_guide.api_version = v1), PostgreSQL 16, and JWT bearer auth (D-t05). Code setting values were read from `repo/` as it is now.

## Code settings

api.base_path: AX-25930
auth.token_ttl: AX-92098
auth.session_cookie: AX-67390
notes.max_length: AX-21323

## Caveats

- `auth.token_ttl` is AX-92098 in the current `repo/auth.py`. `memory/facts.md` still lists AX-46764 (recorded in t04/t05), so that fact is stale. The code value is used here.
- `auth.session_cookie` no longer exists in the current `repo/auth.py`. AX-67390 is the last value recorded in `memory/facts.md` (t04), and I could not confirm it against the code. Treat it as unverified.
- `auth.key_header` has the same drift: the code has AX-47833, and the facts file has AX-96963.

## Operations (all under api.base_path, bearer JWT required)

| Operation | Method and path | Notes |
|-----------|-----------------|-------|
| Create | POST /notes | Body size limited by api.max_body; text limited by notes.max_length |
| Read one | GET /notes/{id} | |
| List | GET /notes | Paged by api.page_size |
| Update | PUT /notes/{id} | Same limits as create |
| Delete | DELETE /notes/{id} | |

Storage is the `notes`, `tags` and `note_tags` tables from t06. Errors use api.error_format.

1	# Decisions (sprint S21)
2	
3	- D-t02: Build against API version v1 with base path api.base_path = AX-25930 (error format api.error_format = AX-78362). Relies on facts: style_guide.api_version = v1, api.base_path = AX-25930, api.error_format = AX-78362. The facts match repo/api.py, so no conflict.
4	- D-t02-v2: Adopt API version v2 for t02-choose-api-version, superseding the earlier v1 choice in D-t02. Relies on fact: style_guide.api_version = v2 (acme-docs/06_api_style_guide_v2.md; v1 guide is withdrawn). Where the older v1 fact and this one disagree, the v2 fact governs because the researcher updated it from the newer style guide and the v1 guide is withdrawn. Follow-up: t12-update-endpoints-for-v2.
5	- D-t05: User traffic uses the security team's scheme: JWT bearer tokens, RS256, 15-minute expiry (auth.token_ttl = AX-46764, auth.key_header = AX-96963 as in repo/auth.py). Relies on facts: security.auth_method (JWT bearer, RS256, 15 min) and customer.auth_method (long-lived API key in `X-Api-Key`). The two conflict; security.auth_method governs because it is the security team's policy and long-lived static keys weaken it. Globex's request is not adopted for user traffic; it is deferred to the account team/security as a separate, scoped machine-credential proposal (e.g. restricted, revocable service tokens) needing security sign-off. Nothing in the code is changed for it now.
6	- D-t13: Reuse the S07 Bolt Billing API billing cycle ("quarterly, invoiced on day 7"; found in history/logs/researcher.jsonl, fact 74f296cb-6df6-5f59-86f6-3dc971410666) and the S13 API-key header ("X-Core-Key"; found in history/logs/planner.jsonl, fact e0bfc28b-0c15-5c06-82d1-c39499d7b337). Code settings stated alongside in artifacts/t13-reuse-billing-cycle/billing-plan.md: billing.cycle = AX-74889, billing.currency = AX-59699 (repo/billing.py). The X-Core-Key header is only for the later service-account keys; user traffic stays JWT per D-t05.
